title: [ACL] SONiC adds “IP Proto” field with “0” value to all rules if user-defined rule does not contain this field
author: bratashX
body:

General support can be found at the following locations:

---------------------------------------------------
BUG REPORT INFORMATION

You do NOT have to include this information if this is a FEATURE REQUEST
-->

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Copy into SONiC table.txt  and rules.txt (attached files)
2. Apply ACL table config `sonic-cfggen -j table.txt --write-to-db`
3. Apply ACL rule config `sudo config acl update full rules.txt`
3. Show config `sudo config save config_with_acl.txt  -y && less config_with_acl.txt`

**Describe the results you received:**
SONiC adds “IP Proto” field with “0” value to all rules if user-defined rule does not contain this field.

ACL rule : 
```
"2": {
    "actions": {
        "config": {
            "forwarding-action": "ACCEPT"
        }
    },
    "config": {
        "sequence-id": 2
    },
    "ip": {
        "config": {
            "destination-ip-address": "192.168.8.1/32"
        }
    }
}
```
ACL rule in config (after applying):
```
        "DATAINGRESS|RULE_2": {
            "DST_IP": "192.168.8.1/32", 
            "IP_PROTOCOL": "0",    <------------------------ !!!!!!!!!!!!
            "PACKET_ACTION": "FORWARD", 
            "PRIORITY": "9998"
        }
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
 “IP Proto” field must be empty if the user-defined rule does not contain this field.

ACL rule : 
```
"2": {
    "actions": {
        "config": {
            "forwarding-action": "ACCEPT"
        }
    },
    "config": {
        "sequence-id": 2
    },
    "ip": {
        "config": {
            "destination-ip-address": "192.168.8.1/32"
        }
    }
}
```
ACL rule in config (after applying):
```
        "DATAINGRESS|RULE_2": {
            "DST_IP": "192.168.8.1/32", 
            "PACKET_ACTION": "FORWARD", 
            "PRIORITY": "9998"
        }
```

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**
SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.783-dirty-20200925.040458
Commit wich changed behaver with  “IP Proto” field:  https://github.com/Azure/sonic-utilities/pull/991/files


[config_with_acl.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5283044/config_with_acl.txt)
[rules.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5283066/rules.txt)
[table.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/5283067/table.txt)

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <daall@microsoft.com>

If you are modifying or removing an existing 'show', 'config' or 'sonic-clear'
subcommand, or you are adding a new subcommand, please make sure you also

your changes.

Please provide the following information:
-->

**- What I did**
Fixes https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5469

It appears that the openconfig model includes a 0 default value, so there's no way to differentiate between a user passing in 0 and a user passing in no value at all, so this will add a "protocol == 0" qualifier to any ACL without a protocol explicitly defined.

**- How I did it**
I removed the `protocol == 0` check.

**- How to verify it**
Load an acl.json (like the one from the issue) with a rule with no IP protocol defined. Verify that no IP protocol qualifier is added to this rule.
